title.narrative: EU REPARIS for SMEs

description.narrative: The activities to be undertaken under this Agreement are part of a follow-up program, REPARIS under the Western Balkans Enterprise Development and Innovation Facility (WB EDIF). This phase II will : a) further improve access of SMEs in the Western Balkans to professional accounting and financial management services, and (b) support the alignment of Western Balkan corporate financial reporting frameworks with relevant EU directives and regulations.
